Annual property returns, by 31st January.-AII Government servants belonging to Group 'A', 'B', 'C' and erstwhile Group 'D'Officers shall submit an annual return "as on 31st December" every year giving full particulars of immovable property inherited/owned/acquired/held by them on lease or mortgage either in their own name, or in any of their family member's name, or in any other person's name.
